title: Call for more food funding due to high living cost
summary: A deputy is calling for increased food funding, arguing that rising living costs weren't adequately considered when a support program ended. This highlights ongoing concerns about food insecurity amid economic pressures.
content: Deputy Louise Doublet does not think the cost of living was considered in the ending of a trial.

zh.title: 由于生活成本高而呼吁增加食品资金
zh.summary: 一位副议员呼吁增加食品资金，辩称在支持计划结束时没有充分考虑生活成本上升。这凸显了经济压力下对粮食不安全的持续关注。

title: Charity reflects on changing needs over 25 years
summary: A long-standing charity marks 25 years of service while reflecting on how community needs have evolved. The organization has distributed over £1.2 million in essential support to vulnerable families.
content: Help a Guernsey Child says it has provided in excess of £1.2m worth of essential support.

zh.title: 慈善机构回顾25年来不断变化的需求
zh.summary: 一个历史悠久的慈善机构庆祝25年的服务，同时反思社区需求如何演变。该组织已向弱势家庭分配了超过120万英镑的基本支持。

title: Nightclubs are disappearing - and it's affecting young people
summary: The closure of nightclubs is reshaping youth culture and social outlets in communities across regions. Young people report losing important spaces for relaxation and social connection.
content: One young person said with no nightlife in their town they cannot "let loose and mess around".

zh.title: 夜总会正在消失——它正在影响年轻人
zh.summary: 夜总会的关闭正在重塑各地区社区的青年文化和社交场所。年轻人报告说失去了放松和社交联系的重要场所。

title: Trump's Russia diesel deal may offer Putin more than money — and spell trouble for Ukraine
summary: A proposed U.S.-Russia diesel deal raises geopolitical concerns beyond immediate financial gains, potentially weakening Ukraine's negotiating position and complicating U.S. support strategies. Experts warn the agreement could embolden Putin's strategic calculations.
content: Trump's diesel deal may do little for Russia's finances, but it raises bigger questions about Ukraine's leverage, U.S. support and Putin's next moves.

zh.title: 特朗普与俄罗斯的柴油交易可能给普京带来的不仅仅是金钱——并可能给乌克兰带来麻烦
zh.summary: 提议的美俄柴油交易引发了超越直接财务收益的地缘政治担忧，可能削弱乌克兰的谈判地位并使美国支持策略复杂化。专家警告该协议可能鼓励普京的战略考量。

title: Some companies give AI to everyone. This CEO is doing the opposite
summary: While many companies democratize AI access across their workforce, Paysend's CEO takes a contrarian approach by restricting advanced AI tools to high-performing employees. The strategy reflects divergent philosophies on AI adoption and workplace productivity.
content: Paysend CEO Ben Chisell limits AI tools to top performers as other U.K. companies push broader workplace rollouts.

zh.title: 有些公司向所有人提供人工智能。这位首席执行官做的完全相反
zh.summary: 虽然许多公司在整个员工队伍中民主化人工智能访问，Paysend的首席执行官采取了相反的方法，限制高级人工智能工具仅供高绩效员工使用。该策略反映了人工智能采用和工作场所生产力上的不同哲学。
